"Period-over-period growth" measures how a metric changes relative to the same type of period in the past — such as comparing this month's sales to last month's (month-over-month, MoM), this quarter's to last quarter's (quarter-over-quarter, QoQ), or this year's to last year's (year-over-year, YoY).
